question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by the 2018 removal of presidential term limits and the absence of designated successors or organized opposition, underpins trader expectations that he will remain in office through 2026. As of mid-2026, official activities—including New Year addresses, diplomatic engagements, and preparations for the 21st Party Congress—show no signs of internal challenges or health-related withdrawals that could trigger removal. Elite reshuffles and purges have instead aligned key positions with loyal figures. While abrupt health events, severe economic downturns sparking elite dissent, or unforeseen crises remain theoretically possible triggers for change, current evidence points to sustained control extending past the market’s resolution window.
